intended_outcome: Make the learned host memory reserve observable in model admission and measurable through a controlled benchmark.
evidence: The reasoning organ records failure outcomes.
The current implementation applies a bounded additional memory reserve.
No exact-device memory or quality benchmark is attached.
acceptance_criteria: A test proves the learned reserve is bounded and affects admission decisions.
The benchmark reports quality, latency and peak memory with the strategy enabled and disabled.
risks: An excessive reserve could deny a useful model tier.
Synthetic host measurements may not predict sustained real-device behaviour.
rollback_expectation: Revert the proposal branch without changing the installed app or continuity data.
unresolved_questions: What reserve gives the best quality and latency trade-off on the target phone?
